# Workshop extension costs

Source: [Workshop Extensions](../archive/1862.md); page edited 2023-04-13.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/1862.md#wiki-1862) before using these values.

Source economy dated 2023-04-13: each disabled player slot earns4points; enabling only Workshop maps earns16points.

The effect-count description is broad. Play Effect one-shot visuals and persistent Create Effect handles have different lifecycle/capacity behavior; do not use this table to infer unlimited execution cost.

- [Extension points](#wiki-1862-table-1)

## Extension points

| Extension | Cost | Effect / constraint |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Beam Effects | 2 | Create Beam Effect types; non-team colors choose a team color |
| Beam Sounds | 1 | Create Effect sounds |
| Buff and Debuff Sounds | 2 | Create Effect / Play Effect sounds |
| Buff Status Effects | 2 | Create / Play Effect; radius ignored; team color; first-person position expects a player |
| Debuff Status Effects | 2 | Create / Play Effect; radius ignored; team color; first-person position expects a player |
| Energy Explosion Effects | 4 | Play Effect; radius ignored; team color |
| Explosion Sounds | 2 | Play Effect sounds |
| Kinetic Explosion Effects | 4 | Play Effect; radius ignored; team color |
| Play More Effects | 1 | Doubles allowed simultaneous effects (source wording; compare resource-specific limits) |
| Projectiles | 4 | Adds projectile types |
| Spawn More Dummy Bots | 2 | Adds 12 dummy-bot capacity |
